description: Validation of the Section 6 noncentral chi2 power: H1 (dark-companion BSPL) truths at 12 cells of the Asimov grid chosen by roman_sec6_power.py --select-validation (lambda 6-45, isotropic geometries, cycling over g and F146), 100 noise realizations each at the cell geometry. Catalog: build_h1_bspl_catalog.py --sec6-validation. Runner with --truth-kind h1a (Test A fits only), SAVE_ARRAYS=1 and fit_policy_test_a_dark_v4.json, then lrt_omega_profile.py with the same policy (one start), as the H0 calibration gv_sec6_h0_v1. Compare with roman_sec6_power.py --validate.
